prompt_head:
Job: Forward Deployed Engineer (Fort Lauderdale/Miami) at TribalScale
<requirements>
- (required) Professional experience building and deploying production-grad

paragraphs.text: I’m applying for the Forward Deployed Engineer role because it calls for building and deploying production‑grade AI software. My background as a systems architect includes four years of end‑to‑end platform delivery and AI‑agent workflows.

At tycodes.app I built a six‑stage agent pipeline that ingests a business URL, collects data, generates a brief, configures pricing, verifies claims, and publishes a shoppable 3D demo. The verification stage automatically blocks hallucinated prices before publishing. The flow runs on Cloudflare Workers and Workflows and finishes in about a minute. I also created the demo generator that stitches together Cloudflare R2 storage, D1 database, and OpenAI models to produce the interactive experience. Separately, I architected and deployed linkme‑intops, a CRM module built with React and TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers, giving staff a dedicated interface for high‑value accounts. I added custom data ingestion modules and analytics pipelines that cut service delivery times by over 30 percent. Earlier, I led a modernization effort that moved a legacy desktop system to cloud‑native web infrastructure, lowering manual data processing overhead by 68 percent.

I have limited exposure to graph‑based orchestration and state‑machine frameworks. To close that gap I will complete a focused training course on workflow graph design, then build a prototype that maps multi‑agent steps onto a state machine using an open‑source library. I will review the prototype with senior engineers and iterate based on feedback.
I would welcome a conversation to explore how my end‑to‑end AI pipeline experience can help TribalScale deliver production systems. Thank you for your consideration.
